description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the task

prompt.description: The task for the agent to perform

harness.description: Which runner executes the task. Defaults to letta (a Letta subagent). Use claude-code, codex, cursor, or opencode to start that external coding worker instead.

subagent_type.description: The type of specialized Letta subagent to use for this task, from the agents listed under Available Agents (for example recall, or a custom agent). Only applies to harness letta. Omit it for the default agent.

fork_context.description: Start the agent with this conversation's full history so the prompt can refer to earlier context. Defaults to false (the agent starts fresh with only the prompt). Cannot be combined with agent_id or conversation_id.

model.description: Optional except for new cursor sessions, which require a Cursor model ID (list IDs with `letta model list --worker cursor`). When omitted, Letta subagents inherit the parent's model and claude-code/codex use that CLI's own default model.

agent_id.description: Deploy an existing agent instead of creating a new one. Starts a new conversation with that agent.

conversation_id.description: Resume from an existing conversation. Does NOT require agent_id (conversation IDs are unique and encode the agent).

computer.description: Run the subagent on another connected computer instead of this machine. Prefer a stable device ID or computer name; ephemeral connection IDs are also supported to pin a specific listener. Pass "cloud" to provision a Cloud sandbox for the subagent's conversation. Fails fast if the device is offline or does not support routing. Omit this field to run on the current machine (the default) — only set it when the task specifically needs to run elsewhere.

mcp.description: External coding workers automatically inherit parent MCP discovery. Use this to opt out or advertise a subset; it does not change authorization.

inherit.description: Inherit MCP discovery metadata (default true). Set false to omit the discovery reminder.

servers.description: Optional exact subset of parent MCP server names to advertise. Requires inherit: true.
